title: Musical Instruments
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
Musical instruments
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have been tidying the house.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸正在收拾房子。

lines.en: Mummy Pig and I found this old box in the attic.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和我在阁楼发现了这个旧盒子。

lines.en: Can anyone guess what's inside?
Nope, it's full of musical instruments.
Wow!
They are a bit old and dusty.
This is the violin I used to play when I was little.
lines.zh: 这是我小时候拉的小提琴。

lines.en: Mummy, can you play your violin?
I haven't played it for a long time.
Please Mummy, please play it.
I hope I haven't forgotten how.
lines.zh: 我希望我没有忘记怎么做。

lines.en: Mummy, can I play the violin?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我可以拉小提琴吗？

lines.en: Hold it like this.
Yes Mummy!
Oh dear, I do not think it is meant to sound like that.
lines.zh: 哦，亲爱的，我不认为这听起来是这样的。

lines.en: George wants to try.
Hold it like this George.
Oh, that does not sound quite right either.
lines.zh: 哦，这听起来也不太对劲。

lines.en: The violin is too hard to play.
Peppa, maybe you would do better with this tin drum.
lines.zh: 佩奇，也许你用这个锡鼓会做得更好。

lines.en: Thank you Daddy.
That sounds better. Peppa loves playing the drum.
lines.zh: 听起来好多了。佩奇喜欢打鼓。

lines.en: Oh lovely!
Yes, it sounds very nice.
This is Daddy Pig's old accordion.
lines.zh: 这是猪爸爸的旧手风琴。

lines.en: I used to play this to Mummy Pig when we first met.
lines.zh: 我们第一次见面的时候我经常给猪妈妈玩这个。

lines.en: Oh Daddy Pig, I remember this tune.
lines.zh: 哦猪爸爸，我记得这首曲子。

lines.en: George wants to play the accordion too.
Are you sure George?
The accordion is quite difficult.
George, the accordion is almost as difficult to play as my drum.
lines.zh: 乔治，手风琴几乎和我的鼓一样难演奏。

lines.en: OK George.
Maybe George is a bit too little to play the accordion.
lines.zh: 也许乔治太小了，无法拉手风琴。

lines.en: Daddy, what other instruments are in the box?
lines.zh: 爸爸，盒子里还有什么乐器？

lines.en: Just this horn.
Can I try?
You have to blow it very hard.
lines.zh: 你必须非常用力地吹它。

lines.en: That does not sound right.
It is impossible.
I think I used to be able to play it.
That really does not sound right.
Maybe it just needs someone big and strong like me.
lines.zh: 也许它只需要像我这样又大又强的人。

lines.en: That does not sound right either.
Peppa's right. It is impossible to play.
lines.zh: 佩奇说得对。这是不可能玩的。

lines.en: Never mind Daddy Pig. Just stick to the accordion.
lines.zh: 别介意猪爸爸。只要坚持手风琴即可。

lines.en: You play it beautifully.
Well I do play it quite nicely, even if I say so myself.
lines.zh: 嗯，我确实弹得很好，即使我自己这么说。

lines.en: And I'll play my violin.
And I will play my drum.
Mummy Pig plays the violin.
Daddy Pig plays the accordion.
Peppa plays the drum.
But what instrument will George play?
lines.zh: 但是乔治会演奏什么乐器呢？

lines.en: George is blowing the horn.
Mummy couldn't play the horn.
And Daddy couldn't play it.
And even I couldn't play it.
But George can play it.
Thanks for watching. Please like, share and subscribe.
lines.zh: 感谢您的观看。请喜欢、分享和订阅。
